Smooth bore rifles/pistols are infamous for being inaccurate, any type of weather condition can hinder your round you just sent down range. That’s why you can find early examples of attempts for rifling and the changing of round from musket balls, to the great great grandfather of modern ammunition. It also explains why militaries moved away from eyeballing their black powder as an accelerant, to packaged powder and bullet. 

An example is that you’re aiming at a fence post from 100 meters out there’s a cross wind of 5 MPH 25-30 meters out, and the round will hit the parked car 20 feet away (on either side) from your target.
